surface.name: quotadial.com
surface.subject: QuotaDial: a menu bar and tray app, command, local API and MCP server that shows how much of each Claude and ChatGPT/Codex plan limit is used and when it resets
surface.audience: Developers who pay for Claude or ChatGPT and work in Claude Code or the Codex CLI, on macOS, Windows or Linux
surface.job: Make the offer clear in one screen (every limit and its reset in view, no new sign-in, every system) and get the download; then sell Pro, hand a buyer their key, and answer privacy and support questions
productTruth: README.md, docs/INSTALL.md, docs/CLI.md, docs/PRIVACY.md, CHANGELOG.md, SECURITY.md in the repository
Decisions D-098 (site, no price in the repository) and D-102 (the key page's function)

affectedSharedSurfaces: apps/tray/scripts/check-window.mjs (captures the app's window for the site)
excluded: Deployment and the domain: built, not deployed, until Matt says
Docs pages rendered from docs/INSTALL.md and docs/CLI.md (queue item 12)
Guides per provider for the informational limit searches (later)
Analytics: no service chosen; events reach a local adapter only

direction.territory: The tide table and the almanac: predicted times in tables, curves against a high-water line, nautical chart colours
direction.rationale: Assigned by the concept roll (seed recorded in docs/seo/site.config.json) from seven grounded candidates; it carries QuotaDial's distinct fact, prediction of when a limit runs out against when it resets, in the form people have long read predicted times in, and avoids the category's centred Mac-app hero and its dark docs template. The strongest challenger, an oscilloscope bench, was set aside because its phosphor-on-black grammar is the category's own costume.
direction.signature: The almanac plate: the real QuotaDial window over a tide table of predictions, under the week's curve meeting the dashed high-water line before the reset mark
palette: Reserved accent chart magenta #a8005f (dark #ff6db5 text, #c2186f fill): the primary action, a runs-out-first prediction, the focus ring and the one caution on the unsigned-build steps; nowhere else
typography: Display and headings: Sofia Sans Condensed variable, 650 to 800; its italic for chart labels
Reading: Sofia Sans variable, 400 and 600, 17 to 18 px, line height 1.55, 65 to 72 characters
Tables and figures: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed with tabular figures
direction.layout: A 12-column grid, max width 1280 px, 24 px gutters (16 px under 768). Bands of depth tone descend the page; the home hero is split 5 and 7 columns, never centred; sections change layout family down the page (split plate, table, code beside text, three systems in a row of unequal widths, the address list, two lists side by side, questions in two columns)
direction.motion: One authored moment, on the home page only: the curve draws to its prediction as the dial's needle sweeps to the share used, about 900 ms ease-out from a visible state; reduced motion shows the final state
direction.density: Moderate (4 of 10): tables carry real numbers; reading blocks stay short; generous space between bands
direction.copyVoice: Plain, specific and numerate, second person, British English; the product's words (window, reset, sign-in); built from docs/copy/source-library.md under codus-copy
accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in light and dark, measured at runtime on every page
Keyboard reach and visible focus (magenta ring) on every control; skip link
Every chart has a table equivalent; images of the app have alt text saying they show example accounts
prefers-reduced-motion removes all movement; nothing cut off at 200% zoom; 390 px with no horizontal scroll
antiDefaults: No kicker or eyebrow above a heading
No cream, parchment or paper ground; no centred hero; no three equal cards; no icon-in-a-square grids
No gradient text; no photograph under a dark overlay; no neon on black; no monospace outside code
No nautical clip-art (anchors, ropes, wheels, waves as ornament)
No interface drawn from divs to look like the app: the real window only
No price, rating, user count, countdown or testimonial; no 'Get started' or 'Learn more'; no em dashes

implementation.componentSystem: The site's own primitives (Section, Plate, TideTable, TideCurve, AppShot, Dial, Button, CodeBlock, Notice, Question, Header, Footer) on Next.js App Router exported as static files, Tailwind v4 with every default colour and font cleared, Phosphor icons
constraints: Static export served by Cloudflare Pages beside functions/api/key.ts; no server code beyond that function

Dependencies: next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss with @tailwindcss/postcss, @phosphor-icons/react, the four @fontsource-variable faces, and a Markdown renderer for PRIVACY.md and CHANGELOG.md; nothing else without the Brain
No cookies, no third-party scripts, no analytics service; events go to a local adapter
No price, no dollar amounts, no 'Pro price', 'lifetime' or 'per month' anywhere in the repository
Contract, seed and reviewer text never in served HTML or public assets

acceptance.statement: At 390x844 the home page shows the H1 (with claude, usage and tracker), the answer sentence, the download action and the start of the app plate without scrolling
Every page measures WCAG AA contrast for every text and its ground, in light and dark
No price, rating, user count, countdown or testimonial appears anywhere on the site or in its source
Every picture of the app is a capture of the real QuotaDial window with example accounts, labelled as example
/key shows a designed state for no link, checking, the key with a working copy button, and each refusal /api/key can give, in the function's own sentence
/privacy renders docs/PRIVACY.md and /changelog renders CHANGELOG.md at build time, word for word
Magenta appears only on the primary action, a runs-out-first prediction, the focus ring and the unsigned-build caution
With reduced motion, nothing on any page moves
seo-check.mjs passes on the production build: one H1 per page, the approved titles, canonicals, required sections, icons and share metadata, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and a 404 status
Every control is reachable by keyboard with a visible focus ring, and the header menu works by keyboard under 768 px
Download actions go to QuotaDial's GitHub releases for the visitor's system; /pro's buy action uses the configured checkout link, or says buying opens soon when none is configured
